title: Introduce entropy-based anomaly scorer and token-lineage telemetry
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: alert fatigue on token-level SLO anomalies and noisy long-tail alerts make incident triage slow. This PR implements a lightweight, entropy-based anomaly scoring pipeline and attaches compact token-lineage attributes to traces to make root-cause attribution faster and cheaper. The goal is to reduce false-positive rate for token-level anomaly alerts while preserving signal on true regressions and to enable cheap joins between traces and tokenized cost/latency telemetry.

What this change does: adds a server-side entropy scorer that consumes token stream histograms and sequence-level entropy deltas to produce a normalized anomaly_score metric; propagates a stable token_lineage_id (SHA256-based short id) through OTEL spans and logs; enriches span tags with token_lineage attributes (prefix_hash, seed_length, quant_profile) for low-cardinality joins; ships a new dashboard and alert updates; adds a migration path and feature flag for gradual rollout.

Design notes: entropy scorer runs in the telemetry ingestion pipeline with two modes: streaming (per-request fast approximation using incremental histogram sketch) and batch (windowed reservoir for more precise scoring). The scorer produces both a gauge (token_entropy) and an anomaly_score (0..1) plus categorical reasons (e.g. "kv_cache_miss_entropy", "prompt_shift_entropy") for downstream grouping. Token_lineage_id is intentionally short (base62 12 chars) to avoid high-cardinality explosion; full provenance is kept in a separate, TTL-limited blob store for deep investigations.

API and schema changes: added metrics: redwood.telemetry.token_entropy (gauge), redwood.telemetry.token_anomaly_score (gauge), redwood.telemetry.token_lineage_samples (counter). New span attributes: telemetry.token_lineage_id, telemetry.token_prefix_hash, telemetry.seed_length, telemetry.quant_profile. OTLP exporter and internal log enricher are updated to include these attributes when present.

Rollout plan: behind feature flag telemetry.entropy_anomaly.enabled (default: off). Step 1: enable streaming scoring for 10% of traffic and export metrics only (no alerts). Step 2: enable lineage propagation for 10% of traffic; validate cardinality and storage. Step 3: promote to 50% and update alert thresholds; Step 4: full rollout and deprecate previous heuristic alert. Rollback via flag toggle.

Observability artifacts: added Grafana dashboard snapshots and a lightweight Kibana view for token-lineage joins. Alerts: replaced the previous token-slo-long-tail alert with TOKEN_ANOMALY_SMALL (windowed, p95 scoring threshold) and TOKEN_ANOMALY_AGG (aggregated across prefix cohorts). Alert tuning guidance included in runbook.

Performance and cost: streaming scorer adds ~0.7% CPU for the telemetry ingestion fleet in our benchmark (1k rps synthetic token bursts). Storage impact controlled by base62 lineage id + TTLed blob store; expected cardinality growth measured and capped via sampling policy (token_lineage_sample_rate, default 0.02). Benchmarks show ~18% reduction in noisy alert volume on a Canary (50k requests/day) and 12% lower median time-to-root-cause in SRE tabletop simulation.

Security and privacy: no raw prompt contents are stored in lineage blobs. Prefix_hash is a salted HMAC of the first N tokens (configurable) and is non-reversible. This was reviewed by security (Maya).

Compatibility: no changes to public API surface for users of Redwood API. Internal SDKs are augmented to propagate telemetry.token_lineage_id when available; fallbacks are safe.

Testing: unit tests for scorer math and propagator included (telemetry_test.go); integration job added to CI that runs scorer on replayed traces (small synthetic corpus). Load test harness shows negligible tail latency impact on ingestion pipeline.

Docs & runbook: added docs/runbooks/entropy-anomaly-tuning.md and docs/telemetry/token-lineage.md describing interpretation, thresholds, and troubleshooting steps.

Migration steps for infra teams: update OTEL collectors to v0.35+ for attribute passthrough; enable feature flag in canary; monitor token_lineage cardinality dashboard.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Dashboard & alert updates - [x] Runbook and docs - [x] Security review - [x] Canary rollout plan

Why unique: unlike previous work which focused on cost-attribution rollups or token heatmaps, this PR targets anomaly reduction via an entropy-first signal and provides a low-cardinality lineage key to tie telemetry together for faster triage.

review_comments:
Leo Zhang: Can we quantify the expected cardinality growth with the default sampling? Please add a dashboard panel that shows unique token_lineage_id per hour.

Ava Martinez: Added panel to dashboard; included cardinality estimates in docs and added sampling config. Estimated unique IDs: ~30k/day for high-throughput tenants at 2% sampling.

Maya Patel: Security review done. Concerned about accidental prompt capture — ensure we never store raw token slices and add automated scrub tests.

Ava Martinez: Added scrub tests and confirmed HMAC prefix hashing.

Jonah Reed: CI flaked on integration test once, reran and passed. Also asked to add a fast-path that skips lineage propagation for sub-10-token system prompts.

Ava Martinez: Implemented skip for short prompts and added unit tests.

Approvals: Leo and Maya approved with comments addressed. Jonah gave final +1 after CI green.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash merge on 2026-02-19 after CI green. Release note: Add entropy-based token anomaly scoring and token-lineage telemetry for improved triage and reduced alert noise. Feature behind telemetry.entropy_anomaly.enabled flag.
release_notes: Add entropy-based anomaly scoring and token-lineage telemetry. Metrics: redwood.telemetry.token_entropy, redwood.telemetry.token_anomaly_score. New span attributes for lineage. Feature gated; see docs for rollout and tuning.
notes_for_release: Enable behind flag; watch dashboards: Observability / Entropy Anomalies and Token Lineage Cardinality. Default sampling is conservative (2%). Follow runbook if token_lineage cardinality > expected thresholds.
security_review_notes: Security reviewed (Maya Patel): no raw prompt storage, prefix hash uses HMAC with per-tenant salt, lineage blobs TTLed and access-controlled.
human_summary: Implements an entropy-based anomaly scorer and token-lineage propagation to reduce noisy token-level alerts and speed up triage. Includes metrics, span attributes, dashboards, alerts, docs, and a controlled rollout behind a feature flag.
